points: Pour the boiled water into a large saucepan with ¼ tsp salt on high heat
Add the rice and cook for 12-13 mins.
Once cooked, drain in a sieve and pop back in the pan. Cover with a lid and leave to the side until ready to serve.
steps.title: Cook the Rice

points: Meanwhile, trim the green beans, then cut into thirds.
Heat a large frying pan on medium-high heat (no oil).
Once hot, add the beef mince and green beans. Fry until the mince has browned and beans are tender, 6-7 mins.
Use a spoon to break up the mince as it cooks.

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw mince.

steps.title: Fry the Beef

points: Meanwhile, trim the pak choi, then thinly slice widthways.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).
steps.title: Prep Time

points: When the mince has browned, drain and discard any excess fat. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the garlic, pak choi and Thai style spice mix (add less if you'd prefer things milder) to the pan. Stir-fry, 1 min.

notes.text: The mince is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Bring on the Flavour

points: Stir the hoisin sauce, teriyaki sauce and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount) into the pan.
Simmer until slightly reduced, 3-4 mins. Remove from the heat.
Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed.
steps.title: Sauce Things Up

points: Share the jasmine rice between your bowls.
Top with the sweet and sticky beef.
Sprinkle over the sesame seeds to finish.
steps.title: Time to Serve
